wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no adjustment or normalisation happens between the request values and the protected operation; the collection slug and identifiers are used verbatim
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: identifiers are accepted as a string or a number and passed unchanged; there is no alternate spelling or format that a guard and the operation could parse differently
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the authority is the request's user; the plugin gate denies an absent user and the collection rules deny an absent role, so there is no fail-open secret/role lookup
